posts.text: Aaron Rodgers says he feels fresh: “I was a little smarter about my workouts leading up to this season, But I feel really good. The legs feel good. I feel good moving around. And I feel like I'm just going to keep on getting better. I think anybody over 35 realizes it's a little different when you wake up at 25 compared to 35. You might be rolling out of bed a little bit slower. That first foot hits the ground, you might be feeling something. I'm 42, so the body feels a little different. Arm feels great. The arm feels fantastic.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Vince Williams thought Steelers defense looked smarter: “I think this scheme is easier on the middle linebackers. One thing that I noticed for sure, they didn’t look confused at all. I don’t want to undermine Patrick Graham by saying, ‘He runs a very easy scheme.’ There is something to be said about everybody being on the same page. There was no confusion. There wasn’t any of those typical Steelers blown plays where you’ll just see a guy wide the freak open. One hundred percent the defense looked smarter. We always historically had those plays where we go out there and shoot ourselves in the foot. We struggled playing against athletic and talented tight ends as well, and we played one of the most athletic and talented tight ends in the league, and he didn’t bite us at all.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Christian Gonzalez on DK Metcalf: “He’s obviously a very strong, physical receiver, very fast, can run. They do a lot with him, so I’m just excited for the matchup. I respect his game. He’s been doing it for a while. He’s been a number one receiver in this league. I think what’s changed is I saw him in my second year last year, so just learning the game more, understanding a little bit more. Just excited for another opportunity.” #Steelers #NFL
